blocks.text: Election watchdog Parish Pastoral Council for Responsible Voting (PPCRV) on Monday said they have not found any "true irregularities" so far on its ongoing audit of the results of the recently recently-concluded Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) elections.
